integrity.limits: Finite computation corroborates rather than proves the all-n argument
integrity.proof_method: Toric fan-edge and saturated-lattice computation, all parameters n>=3
integrity.reproducibility: Python 3 standard library checker included; finite cases n=3 through n=9

scientific_limitations: Classifies exactly the codimension-two singular components for complex n>=3. Does not classify higher-codimension singularities or dimension two. Independent historical priority remains provisional because an overlapping later preprint could not be fully inspected.
title: Codimension-two cyclic quotient strata of the Liu–Zhu toric Fano family
